semiconductor_relevance: High — STREICHER specializes in custom-made vacuum chambers and systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: STREICHER manufactures custom HV and UHV vacuum chambers and turn-key systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. They provide a comprehensive range of services from initial design to precision manufacturing and assembly, ensuring high-quality vacuum solutions for various applications.
capabilities: Custom HV and UHV vacuum chambers
Precision cleaning procedures for vacuum performance

regional_presence.Czech Republic: STREICHER operates through its subsidiaries in Plzen and Deggendorf, contributing to the Czech National Semiconductor Cluster.
